title: Bounded buffer whose tests can be tuned to provoke failures
task: Write a bounded FIFO buffer in package `buffer` with `Put(item int)` blocking when full, `Take() (int, bool)` blocking when empty and reporting false once the buffer is closed and drained, and `Close()`. Producers and consumers run as goroutines; the test must let me tune the number of producers, consumers, and the capacity, run with more goroutines than cores, and verify every item arrives exactly once.
